chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmud, said:
I said to al-Rida عليه السلام: Should I perform istilam of the Yemeni, the Syrian, and the Western corners? He said: Yes.

key_terms.أَسْتَلِمُ: Should I touch or perform istilam
key_terms.الرِّضَا: Imam al-Rida عليه السلام, the Imam being asked for the ruling
key_terms.نَعَمْ: yes; an affirmative answer indicating permissibility

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform istilam of all the corners?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal question posed to Imam al-Rida عليه السلام about touching or performing istilam of multiple corners. The Imam عليه السلام affirms the permissibility of istilam of the Yemeni, Syrian, and Western corners.
